subject: Confirm your M'Arte subscription
preview: One tap confirms your place on the list.
heading: Confirm your subscription
message: Someone — we hope you — asked for M'Arte letters at this address. Confirm below and you will hear from the atelier about new pieces and quiet news.
messageSecondary: If this was not you, simply ignore this email and nothing will happen.
unsubscribeNote: You can leave the list at any time from the link at the bottom of every letter.
